observations.finding: The primary population comprises predicted endpoint coordinates in world angstroms, observed at 50 generation-clock nodes 0.00 through 0.49 within [0,0.5]. Regional contrasts equally average children within extant parent and score stratum, then batches. The independent unit is 14 batches, not descendants or 700 batch-nodes. Terminal score time is 0.99 and terminal state time is 1.0; neither is a contemporaneous early-window state or selection score.

Whole-window high-versus-low selection summaries associate smaller shape_xx and shape_yy with selection (z=-0.495, CI [-0.648,-0.320], q=0.000813; z=-0.513, CI [-0.620,-0.424], q=0.0000149; negative in 13/14 and 14/14 batches). Pair kernels 1.5, 2.5 and 3.5 have positive contrasts +0.562, +0.631 and +0.540, all positive in 14/14 batches with q<=0.000146. Kernel 7.0 has -0.485, CI [-0.617,-0.357], negative in 14/14 batches. These are geometric selection associations, not interaction energies or proven affinity gains.

Parent-debiased regional enrichment agrees across batches: landmark_00_soft_mass +0.639 z (CI [0.492,0.791], q=0.000188, 14/14 positive); landmark_07_local_cyy -0.646 (CI [-0.768,-0.534], q=0.0000708, 14/14 negative); landmark_06_local_dy +0.425 (CI [0.339,0.515], q=0.000115, 14/14 positive). This supports candidate local geometry hypotheses for the supplied score strata.

Across all 50 observed nodes, these contrasts are not constant directions. Landmark_00_soft_mass starts -0.366 z, peaks +1.641 at t=0.16, and ends -0.275; it is positive at 43/50 nodes. Landmark_07_local_cyy starts -0.127, reaches -1.321 at 0.24, and ends +0.296, negative at 46/50 nodes. Landmark_06_local_dy starts +0.326, peaks +1.270 at 0.20, and ends -0.334, positive at 44/50 nodes. Aggregate selection effects therefore do not specify a uniform late-window force.

Equal-node means over five successive ten-node intervals [0.00,0.09], [0.10,0.19], [0.20,0.29], [0.30,0.39], [0.40,0.49] are respectively +0.410,+1.029,+1.154,+0.455,+0.051 z for landmark_00_soft_mass; -0.650,-0.572,-1.136,-0.711,-0.090 for landmark_07_local_cyy; and +0.235,+0.671,+0.777,+0.420,-0.022 for landmark_06_local_dy. These descriptive contrasts peak in the middle and largely subside late; they summarize endpoint forecasts rather than physical atom motion.

Success/failure endpoint-increment contrast for landmark_00_softmin is -4.914 standardized rate units (CI [-6.855,-2.616], q=0.0461, negative in 13/14 batches), the sole q<0.05 result among 74 supplied increment tests. Its occupancy3 counterpart +4.277 has q=0.0811. Regional enrichment-change and parent-edge rates are distinct estimands: landmark_04_local_dy enrichment-change is -2.347 (q=0.00495), while landmark_04_local_cxx parent-edge contrast is -4.596 (q=0.00325). None is a measured atom velocity or causal terminal-affinity derivative.

Leave-one-batch teacher matching shows compressed salient fields and full Hungarian fixed-frame coordinates retain different information: top-four overlap is 0.470 (batch-bootstrap CI [0.427,0.515]); compressed choice incurs +0.081 A excess fixed-frame RMS (CI [0.070,0.092]). Fixed-frame RMS 0.564 A and proper-rigid RMS 0.529 A are fairly close. Both teacher-score correlations are small: compressed 0.102 [0.065,0.140], full 0.064 [0.021,0.103]. These metrics do not evaluate the complete score-weighted reward or its endpoint Jacobian.

Retain registered incumbent program_20 unchanged as the single candidate for a fresh paired comparison. It has the largest supplied discovery mean_pic50_delta (+0.230299), valid-rate change +0.01, and MMFF relief per heavy median/p90 0.476946/0.954550. Program_3 is almost tied in mean (+0.229293) with p90 1.252575. Program_19 trades a lower mean (+0.212839) for p90 0.907866. Program_4 has a larger best-valid pIC50 (8.558043) but valid-rate change -0.02; program_8 has lower relief p90 (0.731024) but mean gain +0.139001. Discovery summaries support testing, not an established winner or a strain noninferiority conclusion.

hypotheses: Candidate coordinate hypothesis: selection favors a transient mid-window increase in landmark_00 soft mass and reduced landmark_07 local yy spread, with landmark_06 local y displacement also elevated. Test the observed node-specific pattern; defer a uniform sign, a monotone time ramp, and a chemical mechanism because the late contrasts reverse (regional_curves; regional_effects:0; regional_effects:75; regional_effects:62).

Candidate reward hypothesis: retain program_20 endpoint_pointcloud on [0,0.5], with native_rms_ratio=0.33, teacher_neighbors=4, teacher_endpoint_temperature_A2=4.0, teacher_score_beta=2.0, mixture_temperature=0.5 and time_ramp_power=0.0, as registered. Its observed affinity/physical-tail balance merits paired testing against native continuation under matched fresh batches; no scalar change is justified by these uncertain adaptive rankings (quality:program_20; quality:program_3; quality:program_19).

Defer any claim that selection-associated fields improve survival or final affinity. Assess paired batch-level affinity means, attempts/failures and physical tails independently; the candidate may be retained only if fresh outcome evidence supports the stated affinity/strain objective (lineage_support; survival_effects:0; quality:program_20).

counterevidence.finding: None of 24 audited fitted curves passes the supplied fidelity rule. Even the smallest relative node RMSE is 0.386, above 0.35. Pair_kernel_2.5 ends empirically +0.043 z versus fit -0.469, with five strong sign-conflict nodes; shape_yy ends empirically +0.163 versus fit -0.513. Whole-window significance cannot license those fitted runtime directions.

Zero of 400 survival tests passes joint BH q<0.05. Landmark_00 soft mass is +0.365 (CI [0.200,0.515]) but q=0.120; landmark_07 local_cyy is -0.299 with q=0.219; landmark_06 local_dy is +0.162 with CI spanning zero and q=0.598. This weakens transfer from selection to survival but does not prove zero effect or failed affinity.

Small q-values can accompany negligible standardized magnitude: occupancy3 contrasts at landmarks 01, 02 and 05 are -0.00196, -0.0384 and -0.00472 z despite q<0.004. Their significance alone does not justify a reward feature; the supplied selection rule also excludes scale-floor fields.

Compressed descriptors sometimes choose different teachers from full coordinates, but their higher observational teacher-score correlation does not establish superior affinity steering. Excess fixed-frame distance is nonnegative by construction; alignment uses fixed correspondence, and the audit omits reward weighting and the endpoint derivative path.

The retained candidate does not dominate every supplied outcome. Other programs have better maxima or lower physical-tail metrics. No quality confidence intervals or independent confirmation are supplied, so even program_20 mean advantage and absence of material strain regression remain unverified.

limitations: All coordinate evidence is selection-conditioned observational evidence. Endpoint forecasts, selection preference, lineage survival and final predicted affinity have different populations and labels; missing future affinity labels remain missing, not adverse outcomes.

Regional Gaussian fields overlap and omit atom types. Distance, occupancy and coordinate-moment proxies identify no unique residue interaction, bond process or energy. Standardized effects and generation-clock rates are not physical velocities.

Regional exact-node curves cover 63 fields at 0.00 through 0.49, with no supplied nodewise confidence intervals or corrected nodewise tests. Temporal reversals are descriptive. The bound execution contract supports exact learned nodes and native continuation after the window; values at 0.50 or later are not learned here.

Survival coverage is limited: 349/700 batch-nodes have fewer than three distinct ancestors and 531/700 fewer than six; only 17-28 teachers per node, at most two per batch. Repeated descendants add no independent replication, and non-survival supplies no failed-affinity label.

Every discovery-quality row explicitly uses adaptive reused batches. The evidence lacks fresh paired quality uncertainty, complete attempt/failure denominators, and a numerical material-strain threshold. Descriptive means, maxima, validity changes and MMFF median/p90 cannot alone verify the all-attempt objective or declare causal superiority.
